el.Psicoterapia a domicilio, en consultorio: Psychotherapy at home, in the office and online
el.Un espacio terapéutico a la medida de ca: A therapeutic space tailored to each person
el.Soy Yamila Beraja, Licenciada en Psicolo: I'm Yamila Beraja, a psychologist with a degree in Psychology from the University of Buenos Aires (UBA). I work with children, teenagers, young people, adults and older adults, with and without disabilities.
el.El lugar también es parte del tratamient: The place is also part of the treatment
el.No todas las personas pueden o quieren t: Not everyone can, or wants to, travel to an office. That's why we choose together the setting that best suits each patient and their family.
el.Me acerco al espacio habitual del pacien: I come to the patient's own space: their home, an institution, or wherever the treatment makes the most sense. I bring the materials I choose for each person.
el.CABA y Zona Norte y alrededores: CABA, Zona Norte and surrounding areas
el.Un espacio tranquilo y preparado para el: A quiet space, prepared for meeting, play and working with a variety of materials.
el.Cuando la persona lo prefiere y la situa: When the person prefers it and the situation allows. Also available for family guidance and for students.
el.Cada tratamiento se construye de manera: Each treatment is built in its own way, according to each person's story, interests and needs.
el.Sesiones en el espacio habitual del paci: Sessions in the patient's own space, especially suited to situations involving mobility difficulties, particular needs, or when home is the best place to work.
el.Infancias, adultos mayores y personas co: Children, older adults and people with disabilities.
el.Un espacio de escucha y trabajo terapéut: A space for listening and therapeutic work to help you through difficult times and emotional and relational processes, in a quiet office in Villa Crespo or Zona Norte.
el.El mismo espacio de escucha y trabajo te: The same space for listening and therapeutic work, by video call and from wherever you are.
el.Un lugar seguro donde jugar, expresarse: A safe place to play, express themselves and feel heard, respecting the pace of each child. It includes meetings with the family and, when needed, coordination with the school and other professionals.
el.Atención de personas con discapacidad y: Support for people with disabilities and ASD
el.Abordaje adaptado a las características,: An approach adapted to each person's characteristics, ways of communicating and interests, working together with the family and the team of professionals who support them.
el.Niños, adolescentes, jóvenes y adultos c: Children, teenagers, young people and adults with disabilities or an ASD diagnosis.
el.Actividades para trabajar atención, memo: Activities to work on attention, memory, language and planning as part of the therapeutic process, to sustain abilities and encourage autonomy.
el.Adultos mayores y personas con discapaci: Older adults and people with disabilities.
el.Encuentros con madres, padres y familias: Sessions with mothers, fathers and families to reflect together on parenting situations and to support those who provide care.
el.Orientación sobre inclusión y abordaje d: Guidance on inclusion and on addressing individual, group and institutional situations, working with students, families and teams.
el.Propuestas para disfrutar de la cultura: Outings to enjoy culture and the city with professional support.
el.Personas con discapacidad y adultos mayo: People with disabilities and older adults.
el.Acompañamiento online para preparar parc: Online support to prepare for midterms, final exams and coursework in vocational and university programs.
There is no single way to accompany someone. The space, the resources and the format are built together with each person.
el.Me escribís por WhatsApp, me contás la s: You write to me on WhatsApp, tell me about your situation, and we schedule a 30-minute first meeting, priced at $25.000.
el.Nos conocemos, me contás tu historia, tu: We get to know each other. You tell me your story, your needs and what you hope for from psychotherapy. When appropriate, I also meet your family.
el.Armo una propuesta que puede incluir jue: I put together a proposal that may include play, art, materials and activities chosen specifically for that person.
el.Entrevistas con la familia, intercambio: Meetings with the family, exchange with other professionals and with the school or institution (when needed), and external supervision of my work, as part of the ethical practice of the profession.
el.Soy psicóloga y docente. Hace más de 30: I am a psychologist and teacher. For more than 30 years I have worked in education and psychotherapy with children, teenagers, young people and adults, with and without disabilities. I also support older adults, and I have experience with people hospitalized with serious illnesses and in palliative care.

el.¿En qué zonas atendés a domicilio?: Which areas do you cover for home visits?
el.Principalmente en la Ciudad de Buenos Ai: Mainly the City of Buenos Aires and the Zona Norte. If you live somewhere else, write to me and we'll figure it out.
el.Sí, cuando la persona lo prefiere y la s: Yes, when the person prefers it and the situation allows. Guidance for families and students can also be done online.
el.¿Cómo es la primera consulta?: What is the first session like?
el.Empezamos con entrevistas iniciales para: We begin with initial interviews to get to know the person, their story and what they need. From there, we decide together on the format and frequency.
el.¿Trabajás con la familia y con otros pro: Do you work with the family and with other professionals?
el.Sí. Según cada caso, el tratamiento pued: Yes. Depending on the case, treatment may include family meetings and exchange with other health professionals and with the school.
el.¿Qué materiales usás en las sesiones?: What materials do you use in sessions?
el.Elijo los materiales según los intereses: I choose materials according to each patient's interests and possibilities: games, art, cognitive stimulation activities and other resources. It's not about making “something pretty,” but about opening up other ways of expressing oneself.
el.Contame tu situación y conversamos: Tell me your situation and let's talk
el.Escribime por WhatsApp para consultar di: Write to me on WhatsApp to ask about availability, formats and fees.
